title_youtube: Soldiers Reenlisted to Play GTA 6 (The GTA Flu Is Real) 🎮
description_youtube:
One Army unit offered a 4-day pass for the GTA 6 launch to soldiers who reenlisted for at least two more years. Twenty said yes. Meanwhile, almost 1 in 5 full-time workers plan to take launch day off, and half of gamers taking time off for a release say they'll call in sick.

Sources:
- CBS News: https://www.cbsnews.com/news/grand-theft-auto-army-reenlistment-bonus/
- Fortune (Army unit, Aug 2026): https://fortune.com/2026/08/20/grand-theft-auto-six-days-off-from-work-anticipating-gen-z-millennial-hype-rockstar-games-take-two-interactive/
- BambooHR, PTO requests for the GTA VI release: https://www.bamboohr.com/resources/data-at-work/data-stories/gta-pto
- Fast Company, everyone's taking PTO and sick days: https://www.fastcompany.com/91626090/everyones-taking-pto-and-sick-days-to-play-grand-theft-auto-vi
- Fortune (Logitech gaming day off, Nov 2026): https://fortune.com/2026/11/10/logitech-gaming-day-off-ahead-of-grand-theft-auto-six-release-ceo-hanneke-faber-boost-productivity/

#gta6 #gaming #worklife
